task: Help me write a brief account support request without exposing contact details.
text: Hello support team, my email is sora.marden@example.com. I cannot sign in after changing phones and the recovery screen keeps returning to the beginning. I have already tried a different browser, but I have not reset the account. Could you explain what recovery options are available and whether my saved preferences will remain intact? Please keep the tone courteous and concise.

decisions.label: EMAIL
decisions.reason: The email address identifies a contact and could expose their account contact details; the support request does not need the exact address.

task: Draft a generic supplier follow-up for external AI, omitting confidential identities and pricing.
text: Our buyer, Nella Quist, spoke to confidential supplier Reedvale Components about the delayed sample shipment. The supplier said the revised packing list is ready, but the collection time has not been confirmed. Ask for the collection window and the name of a shipping contact without promising a delivery date. The unapproved internal quote is 42,600 euros and must remain confidential.
